_notes.tier_policies: Options per tier: allow, log, notify, block. To run in audit-only mode set tier 4 to 'log'.
_notes.allowed_targets: Substrings — any target containing these strings bypasses the gate. Add your own infrastructure here.
_notes.blocked_targets: Substrings — any target containing these strings is always blocked regardless of tier policy.
_notes.log_all_tiers: Set true to log Tier 1 (read-only) operations to the audit trail.
